question: My AirFiber router's LED is blinking red since this morning. What does that mean and what should I do?

      "text": "Troubleshooting AirFiber connectivity > Router LED status reference\nThe status LED on the front of the AirFiber ONT reports the state of the fiber line.\n\n| LED colour | Pattern | Meaning | What to do |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Green | Solid | Line is active and authenticated | No action needed |\n| Green | Slow blink | Negotiating with the exchange | Wait up to 3 minutes |\n| Red | Solid | No optical signal reaching the ONT | Check the fiber cable for sharp bends, then raise a Line Fault ticket |\n| Red | Blinking | Fiber cut detected between the home and the exchange | Raise a Line Fault ticket; a field engineer visit is required |\n| Orange | Solid | Authenticated but no WAN IP assigned | Power-cycle the ONT for 30 seconds |\n| Orange | Blinking | Firmware upgrade in progress | Do not power off; wait 10 minutes |\n| Off | — | No power to the ONT | Check the adapter and wall socket |"

steps.content:
The blinking red LED on your AirFiber ONT indicates that a **fiber cut has been detected between your home and the exchange**.  

**What to do:**  
1. Raise a **Line Fault ticket** (via the AirFiber app, web portal, or by replying to this email).  
2. A field‑engineer will be dispatched to investigate and repair the cut.

No further action is needed on your side until the ticket is opened and the engineer visits.  

*Source: KB‑004 – “Router LED status reference” (blinking red = fiber cut; raise a Line Fault ticket).*
